prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
engine_stated_criteria: all relevant plans in your county
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong starting point for individual or family coverage: it’s an independent Kansas City–area agency that says it compares Marketplace and private plans across carriers and checks subsidy eligibility. It lists a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews. Call **816-205-4664**. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/)

Two other options to compare:

- **AIS Health Advisors** — serves the metro, including Kansas and Missouri, and helps with ACA Marketplace plans and subsidies. **913-333-8627**. [AIS Health Advisors](https://aishealthadvisors.com/)
- **Apollo Health Insurance** — based in Lee’s Summit and serves the metro; offers individual, family, and Medicare help. **816-400-4477**. [Apollo](https://apollo-insurance.com/health-insurance-broker-kansas-city/)

Before enrolling, ask whether the broker can compare **all relevant plans in your county**, whether they receive commissions from insurers, and whether your doctors, prescriptions, and preferred hospitals are in-network. Your home address matters because Kansas and Missouri residents use different Marketplace options.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
